# Experience Epic Data Speeds

The ROG Strix SQ7 internal M.2 PCIe ® Gen 4 x4 NVMe ® SSD redefines speed with DRAM buffering and a large SLC cache for up to 7000 MB/s data transfers. Built for superior security and accelerated gaming, the Strix SQ7 offers comprehensive hardware encryption and software solutions as well as extensive compatibility with both PCs and PlayStation™ 5. Level up your gaming experiences with faster loading times.

## Unrivaled performance

The ROG Strix SQ7 delivers up to 7000 MB/s sequential read speeds and up to 6000 MB/s sequential write speeds. This is double the speed of standard PCIe 3.0 SSDs, and up to 13X faster than SATA SSDs*.

 

*Actual transfer speed may vary due to device and testing configuration.

## Top-notch components

With a 12 nm E18 controller, DRAM buffering, large SLC cache and low-density parity-check (LDPC), the Strix SQ7 is designed for superfast, stable performance and a longer lifespan.

 

## Comprehensive hardware encryption

The Strix SQ7 is compliant with numerous hardware encryption standards, including the TCG Opal specification, IEEE 1667 protocol, and AES 256-bit disk and data encryption. These hardware-based solutions ensure fast, efficient and superior security without affecting CPU performance.

 

## Complete data protection

The Strix SQ7 includes NTI Backup Now EZ software to protect digital assets from malicious virus attacks and hardware failure. There’s even a data recovery feature to help retrieve any files that have been accidentally deleted.

 

## Easy drive management

The user-friendly ROG SSD Dashboard interface displays vital information such as drive temperature, storage use, device health status, and more.

 

## Wide-ranging compatibility

The Strix SQ7 has a compact M.2 2280 form factor that perfectly fits laptops, desktop PCs and the PlayStation™ 5 console. It ensures superfast load times, making it ideal for gaming enthusiasts looking to boost storage performance.

 

- 1 GB = 1,000,000(10 6) KB, actual storage capacity may vary as some storage capacity is allocated for formatting and other purposes.
